description: Graveyard dirt is used in a variety of rituals and spells in traditional folk magic as well as witchcraft. Many people believe that graveyard dirt carries with it the influence and power of the dead. This authentic dirt was collected from a historic Atlanta cemetery famous for its paranormal activity where the dead are still very much alive. Graveyard dirt can be used with any mixture or ritual to enhance its effectiveness and spiritual properties. Your order includes Madame Yayas Authentic Graveyard Dirt in a 2 by 3 inch bag.
